{{Quote|The wild hubba gourd is our primary food. Without it, we'd perish.|[[Sharad Hett]], to [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="Out" />}}
The '''hubba gourd''' was a type of [[Melon/Legends|melon]] that grew in rock recesses on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Although its juice was sour and difficult to digest for [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the hubba gourd was the main staple [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Tatooine. The name was a translation from a [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] phrase: "the staff of life."

==Description==
{{Quote|For example, I found this ''reflecting crystal'' on the floor, of the type that grows on the husks of hubba gourds...|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]], to [[Ponnar]]|<ref name="War on the Jundland Wastes">{{SWComicCite|7.1|War on the Jundland Wastes}}</ref>}}
Hubba gourds were tough-skinned [[Melon/Legends|melons]]<ref name="Promises" /> that grew in the shadows of the cliffs on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They could be round<ref name="SD" /> or elongated.<ref name="FF63" /> The [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] were normally covered with tiny, reflective [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that protected them from excessive [[Star/Legends|solar]] exposure.<ref name="Promises" /> The gourd's interior was filled with tough, stringy fibers that contained a sour fluid.<ref name="SD" /> During their [[growing season]], hubba gourds were [[Color/Legends|colored]] green,<ref name="War on the Jundland Wastes" /> and they would eventually take a yellowish hue.<ref name="SD" /> When ripe, the fruits also exhaled a distinctive smell.<ref name="SW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> The [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] of the hubba gourd were pale and transparent.<ref name="TST">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

[[File:Unripe_hubbas.png|thumb|left|225px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|manipulating]] unripe hubba gourds]]
The hubba gourd was prime [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]; the latter [[Species/Legends|species]] found it particularly delicious when roasted.<ref name="Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> The word ''hubba'' itself was [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] for "the staff of life," indicating how important it was to that species' survival,<ref name="New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and their efficient digestive systems [[Diet/Legends|drew all the nutrients]] they needed from it.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|species|jawa|Jawa}}</ref> Despite often finding the gourd hard to digest and bitter, other species could also consume it, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="FF63" /> [[Geranite/Legends|Geranites]], and [[Askajian/Legends|Askajians]].<ref name="SD" /> [[Hubba juice]],<ref name="Ab" /> [[hubba bread]],<ref name="Out" /> and [[hubba chips]] could be made from hubba gourds.<ref name="UQ" />

==History==
{{Expandsect}}
{{Quote|You stole the hubba gourds, hoping the Tusken Raiders and the Jawas would fight over them!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]], to [[Ponnar]]|<ref name="War on the Jundland Wastes" />}}
[[File:Hubba_gourd_Jawas_Tusken_Raiders.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Unripe hubba gourds being thrown at hungry Jawas and Tusken Raiders]]
[[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] resident of Tatooine, was at one [[Time/Legends|time]] working on a [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] hubba gourd.<ref name="TST" />

[[Wimateeka]], a Jawa leader of the [[Nkik clan]], once contracted a number of hunters to eliminate wild animals that were attacking his clan's supply of hubba gourds.<ref name="SWG:HGR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Hubba Gourd Raiders}} on Tatooine</ref>
